description: This Java interface defines a mapper for converting Client domain objects into ClientData transfer objects, utilizing MapStruct annotations and custom default methods for enum and status conversions.

classes.name: ClientMapper
classes.description: A MapStruct mapper interface for converting Client domain objects to ClientData DTOs with custom property mappings and helper methods.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Converts a Client object into a ClientData DTO, mapping fields and ignoring UI-related properties.

methods.name: clientTypeCode
methods.description: Returns CodeValueData for the client's type, or null if not available.

methods.name: clientClassificationCode
methods.description: Returns CodeValueData for the client's classification, or null if not available.

methods.name: clientSubStatusCode
methods.description: Returns CodeValueData for the client's sub-status, or null if not available.

methods.name: clientGenderCode
methods.description: Returns CodeValueData for the client's gender, or null if not available.

methods.name: clientLegalFormEnum
methods.description: Returns EnumOptionData representing the client's legal form.

methods.name: clientStatusEnum
methods.description: Returns EnumOptionData representing the client's status.

methods.name: clientTimelineData
methods.description: Constructs ClientTimelineData based on client's status (active, closed, or other).

methods.name: clientIsStaff
methods.description: Returns Boolean indicating if the client is staff.
